Methods of the EntityManager object


 
If you aren’t using a Java EE server, code database operations 
within a 
transaction
. If the transaction is successful, 
commit
 
the 
changes to the database. If the transaction isn’t successful, 
roll 
back
 
any changes. This ensures data integrity.
 

 
JPA may 
flush unsaved changes before you finish a transaction. 
However, if the rollback method of that transaction is called, JPA 
can still roll back those changes.
 

 
A transaction can be rolled back any time before the commit 
method is called, or if the commit meth
od is called but fails.
